## Summary

Describe what this change does and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] `gofmt` checked when Go code changed
- [ ] `go test ./...` passed when applicable
- [ ] `go vet ./...` passed when applicable
- [ ] `git diff --check` passed
- [ ] Focused tests were added for behavior changes

## Safety and privacy

- [ ] No real credentials, logs, bundles, personal data, or private hosts were added
- [ ] Safety gates were not weakened to make tests pass
- [ ] Security and privacy claims remain conservative
- [ ] Command execution changes preserve bounded, explicit behavior

## Documentation

- [ ] README/docs were updated when user-visible behavior changed
- [ ] CHANGELOG was updated when appropriate
